name: AI Harness Assistant
tagline: Keeps every AI coding tool on your machines up to date

source.excerpt: Shared as maintenance for the pile of AI coding tools you already installed.

body:
## What it does

Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode and the rest, updated on a schedule instead of whenever you happen to notice one is three versions behind. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked. It is unglamorous work that everyone postpones, which is exactly the kind of thing worth handing to a bot on a schedule.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @gheeunit shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
